Agentic C++ Debugging C++ Live! - Without a Safety Net  - Daisy Hollman & Mark Williamson - CppCon 2025
---

Mark Williamson (Undo) and Daisy Hollman (Anthropic) will show more in-depth examples of AI-enhanced time travel debugging, with some audience interaction and a preview of some upcoming AI debugging technology. 
---

Sponsored by JetBrains: https://www.jetbrains.com/clion/

Daisy Hollman

Dr. Daisy Hollman is a distinguished software engineer and programming language expert, known for her impactful contributions to the C++ standards committee since 2016. She has worked on C++ language and library design at Google, and more recently joined Anthropic, where she explores the intersection of programming languages and AI systems.
